title: Animetion
description: Scene 1 – The Mystery Color 🌈 0-5 seconds Visual action: - Baby Dino walks into a magical rainbow garden. - He discovers a giant red egg. - He looks surprised and points at the egg. Voiceover: Dino: "Wow! Look what I found!" Narrator: "What color is this egg? Can you guess?" AI video prompt: Cute 3D animated baby green dinosaur with big sparkling eyes and tiny arms walking into a beautiful magical rainbow garden. He suddenly discovers a giant bright RED egg sitting on soft green grass. Dino looks surprised, points at the egg and smiles. Colorful flowers, butterflies and sunshine. Pixar-inspired preschool cartoon aesthetic, smooth camera movement, vibrant colors, vertical 9:16. Scene 2 – Guess the Color! ❤️ 5–11 seconds Visual action: - Camera zooms in on the red egg. - The egg sparkles. - A big question mark appears. - Dino asks the children to guess. Voiceover: Dino: "Hmmmm! What color is it?" Narrator: "Is it RED, BLUE or YELLOW?" Dino: "Let's count! 3... 2... 1!" AI video prompt: Close-up of the same cute baby green dinosaur pointing excitedly at the same giant shiny RED egg. The egg sparkles with magical glitter. Three large colorful answer choices appear one at a time: RED, BLUE and YELLOW, with simple colorful circles. Dino looks curious and waits for the viewer to answer. Bright cheerful preschool 3D animation, vertical 9:16. Scene 3 – The Big Color Reveal! 🎉 11–17 seconds Visual action: - The red egg opens with a magical pop. - Red hearts and sparkles appear. - Dino jumps happily. - Huge RED text appears on screen. Voiceover: Dino: "It's RED!" Narrator: "R-E-D! RED!" Dino: "Yay! Great job, little friends!" AI video prompt: The same giant red egg magically cracks open with a cute popping effect. Bright red hearts, stars and sparkles fly into the air. The same adorable baby green dinosaur jumps happily and claps his tiny hands. Giant bold RED text appears in the center of the screen with a glowing red background. Cute joyful 3D preschool cartoon, smooth animation, vertical 9:16. Scene 4 – Let's Learn Together! 🦖 17–25 seconds Visual action: - Three colorful eggs appear: red, blue and yellow. - Dino points to the red egg. - The red egg glows. - Dino dances and waves goodbye. Voiceover: Dino: "Can you find RED?" Narrator: "Yes! The RED egg!" Dino: "You are amazing! Bye-bye!" AI video prompt: The same adorable baby green dinosaur stands in the same magical rainbow garden. Three large eggs appear beside him: one RED, one BLUE and one YELLOW. Dino points to the red egg, which glows brightly. He dances, waves goodbye and smiles at the camera. Colorful confetti, happy expressions, bright 3D preschool animation, vertical 9:16.
